data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ghanama' which means 'to give' or 'to bestow'. The name Ghanimi is an expression of the idea of receiving a blessing or a gift, and is often given to a child who is considered a blessing or a source of joy and happiness. The name Ghanimi carries the meaning “Gift, Blessing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghanimi usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, blessing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
